# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.7 batch 12 theme-b2: the themes tab's bulk orders (oe_tb2_). Generated by gen_theme_b2.py;
# edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Removes every mark of a 'set as advised' round (themes and BYZ); the records oe_tb2_r_* stay.
oe_tb2_unmark = {
    every_subject = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv has_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p } } remove_variable = oe_tb2_adv remove_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p }
    oe_tb2_unmark_byz = yes
}
oe_tb2_unmark_byz = {
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_n
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_n_c
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_n_p
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_auth
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_nav_plan
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_job
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_p_done
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l1
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l2
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l3
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l4
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l5
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l6
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l7
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l8
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l9
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l10
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l11
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_l12
}

# BYZ scope (the confirmation event's immediate). Plans the round with the AI's rules and marks the themes.
oe_tb2_mark = {
    oe_tb2_unmark = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n_c value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n_p value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_nav_plan value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_auth value = oe_tb2_auth_now }
    every_subject = {
        limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        # course: the parts of oe_ta_ai_wants_change, in its order; the navy cap counts the planned naval themes
        if = {
            limit = {
                oe_ta_can_change_course = yes
                has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band var:oe_theme_loyalty_band >= 2
                c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_auth >= 5 }
            }
            if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_army = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_adv value = 1 } }
            else_if = {
                limit = { oe_ts_core = yes capital = { is_coastal = yes } NOT = { oe_ts_course_navy = yes } c:BYZ = { oe_tb2_navy_room >= 1 } }
                set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_adv value = 2 }
                c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_nav_plan add = 1 } }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_civil = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_adv value = 3 } }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv }
                c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_auth add = -5 } change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n_c add = 1 } }
            }
        }
        # fiscal regime: the AI's pronoia rule
        if = {
            limit = { oe_tb2_pron_adv = yes }
            set_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n_p add = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv has_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p } }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_n add = 1 } }
            save_scope_as = oe_tb2_this
            if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 1 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l1 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 2 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l2 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 3 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l3 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 4 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l4 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 5 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l5 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 6 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l6 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 7 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l7 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 8 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l8 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 9 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l9 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 10 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l10 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 11 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l11 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            else_if = { limit = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_tb2_n = 12 } } c:BYZ = { set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_l12 value = scope:oe_tb2_this } } }
            clear_saved_scope = oe_tb2_this
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (worker, job 1). First run: the pronoia grants, all at once (the body the AI and the officials menu run;
# the monthly pulse calls oe_ti_pronoia_set for many themes in one effect too). Every run: one course change.
oe_tb2_apply_step = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tb2_p_done } }
        set_variable = oe_tb2_p_done
        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_c value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_p value = 0 }
        every_subject = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p }
            remove_variable = oe_tb2_adv_p
            if = {
                limit = { oe_tb2_pron_adv = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_officials_cd years = 2 } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes
                c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_p add = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv } }
        random_subject = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tb2_adv } oe_tb2_course_one = yes }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tb2.9
    }
    else = { oe_tb2_unmark_byz = yes }
}
# Theme scope (worker). One planned course change, checked again (authority, cooldown, the course still open, the
# AI's navy cap with the live count), paid and made as the course menu oe_theme_admin.1 does. The mark goes either way.
oe_tb2_course_one = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    if = {
	        limit = {
	            oe_ta_can_change_course = yes
	            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
	            OR = {
	                AND = { var:oe_tb2_adv ?= 1 oe_ta_course_ok_army = yes }
	                AND = { var:oe_tb2_adv ?= 2 oe_ta_course_ok_navy = yes c:BYZ = { oe_ta_navy_count < oe_ta_navy_cap } }
	                AND = { var:oe_tb2_adv ?= 3 oe_ta_course_ok_civil = yes }
	            }
	        }
	        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
	        if = { limit = { var:oe_tb2_adv ?= 1 } oe_ta_set_course = { course = army } }
	        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tb2_adv ?= 2 } oe_ta_set_course = { course = navy } }
	        else = { oe_ta_set_course = { course = civil } }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus_cd years = 5 }
	        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_c add = 1 } }
	        # the change keeps its seat list and two saved scopes for the rest of the event chain: empty them, so that the
	        # next run's change never builds posts on this theme's land
	        if = {
	            limit = { any_in_list = { list = oe_theme_conversion_locations } }
	            every_in_list = { list = oe_theme_conversion_locations remove_from_list = oe_theme_conversion_locations }
	        }
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_theme_converted_country
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_theme_new_capital
	    }
	    remove_variable = oe_tb2_adv
	}
}

# BYZ scope (worker, job 2). 修缮城堡 in every march that may, highest border pressure first, while the
# treasury can pay: the border line's own action effect, one march at a time.
oe_tb2_all_fortify = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_m value = 0 }
    ordered_subject = {
        limit = { oe_tbd_fortify_target = yes }
        order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key
        max = 99
        check_range_bounds = no
        if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_can_fortify = yes } }
            save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme
            c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_fortify_do = yes change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_m add = 1 } }
            clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope (worker, job 3). 征募边军 in every march that may, highest border pressure first, while the
# treasury can pay: the border line's own action effect, one march at a time.
oe_tb2_all_levy = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_m value = 0 }
    ordered_subject = {
        limit = { oe_tbd_levy_target = yes }
        order_by = oe_tbd_pressure_key
        max = 99
        check_range_bounds = no
        if = {
            limit = { c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_can_levy = yes } }
            save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme
            c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_levy_do = yes change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_r_m add = 1 } }
            clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
        }
    }
}

# ================================================================ 托管 (theme-managed1, design theme-econ 3.2)
# Theme scope. Put under management / take back. The marker oe_te_managed and the price variable oe_te_trib_adj
# (points of the remittance share, read by step 3) go together; the efficiency term reads the marker.
oe_tb2_mg_on = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_managed value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_te_trib_adj value = -10 }
    # review-b: the card's record of an earlier managed spell goes (no old year beside this year's works)
    remove_variable = oe_tb2_t_y
    # batch13e: a question already queued for this theme (it waits for the monthly dispatch) is settled now: 前线暴露 /
    # 边患已平 the AI's way (as hooks I1, I2 answer them in January); a queued border event is dropped (as hooks B1, B2
    # skip the draw). So no popup about this theme comes after it was put under management.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_front } oe_ti_make_frontier = yes }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ti_q_quiet } oe_ti_restore_core = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_merc
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_raid
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_beat
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_flee
    remove_variable = oe_tbd_q_defect
}
oe_tb2_mg_off = {
    remove_variable = oe_te_managed
    remove_variable = oe_te_trib_adj
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_mg_cd months = 12 }
}
# Theme scope (card button, test page). Take back a managed theme, or manage it when it may be.
oe_tb2_mg_toggle = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_te_managed } oe_tb2_mg_off = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_tb2_mg_can = yes } oe_tb2_mg_on = yes }
}
# Theme scope. Monthly from the theme dispatcher (hook; trigger: has_variable = oe_te_managed), after the replenishment.
# An AI empire never manages: the marker is dropped when Byzantium is not the player's (no cooldown).
oe_tb2_mg_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { c:BYZ = { is_ai = yes } }
        remove_variable = oe_te_managed
        remove_variable = oe_te_trib_adj
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now } }
        if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_tb2_mg_year = yes }
        oe_tb2_mg_works = yes
    }
}
# Theme scope. Works: idle for 12 months -> the works line's own automatic choice, without its office-tier gate.
# (oe_theme_works_monthly has already counted the month and started a work when the tier allows.)
oe_tb2_mg_works = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_proj } has_variable = oe_theme_idle var:oe_theme_idle >= 12 }
        oe_theme_works_auto = yes
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_proj }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_w value = 1 }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_w add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}
# Theme scope. The January round: the AI empire's own rules, one theme at a time (each theme's own pulse).
# Records on the theme (read by the card button's tooltip): oe_tb2_t_c course, _p grants, _f castles, _l border troops,
# _w works (this year), _g strategos (0 not due, 1 replaced, 2 no house could, 3 authority under 8); oe_tb2_t_y
# the year. BYZ: oe_tb2_s_* the same counts summed over the managed themes this year (oe_tb2_s_y the year, _n themes).
oe_tb2_mg_year = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
	    c:BYZ = {
	        if = {
	            limit = { NOT = { AND = { has_variable = oe_tb2_s_y var:oe_tb2_s_y >= current_year } } }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_y value = current_year }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_n value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_c value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_p value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_g value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_f value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_l value = 0 }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_w value = 0 }
	        }
	        change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_n add = 1 }
	    }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_y value = current_year }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_c value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_p value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_g value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_f value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_l value = 0 }
	    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_w value = 0 }
	    # course: oe_ta_ai_course, for this theme
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_ta_ai_wants_change = yes international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 25 } }
	        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -5 } }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_focus_cd years = 5 }
	        if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_army = yes } oe_ta_set_course = { course = army } }
	        else_if = { limit = { oe_ta_ai_course_navy = yes } oe_ta_set_course = { course = navy } }
	        else = { oe_ta_set_course = { course = civil } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { any_in_list = { list = oe_theme_conversion_locations } }
	            every_in_list = { list = oe_theme_conversion_locations remove_from_list = oe_theme_conversion_locations }
	        }
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_theme_converted_country
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_theme_new_capital
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_c value = 1 }
	        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_c add = 1 } }
	    }
	    # finance: the AI's pronoia rule
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_tb2_pron_adv = yes }
	        set_variable = { name = oe_theme_fiscal value = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_theme_officials_cd years = 2 } set_variable = oe_theme_tiers_dirty oe_ti_pronoia_set = yes
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_p value = 1 }
	        c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_p add = 1 } }
	    }
	    # strategos: loyalty under 40 and 60 months in office -> the emperor's political ally sends a man (oe_tg_ai_yearly)
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty var:oe_theme_loyalty < 40 has_variable = oe_theme_tenure var:oe_theme_tenure >= 60 NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes } }
	        if = {
	            limit = { NOT = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 8 } } }
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_g value = 3 }
	        }
	        else = {
	            set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_g value = 2 }
	            if = {
	                limit = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_nf_political_ally } }
	                save_scope_as = oe_tg_theme_s
	                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
	                    if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 1 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 1 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 1 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 2 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 2 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 2 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 3 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 3 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 3 } } } else_if = { limit = { oe_nf_is_political_ally = { slot = 4 } oe_tg_slot_has_candidate = { slot = 4 } } c:BYZ = { oe_tg_appoint = { slot = 4 } } }
	                }
	                if = {
	                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_tg_nominee has_ruler = yes ruler = scope:oe_tg_nominee }
	                    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_g value = 1 }
	                    c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_g add = 1 } }
	                }
	                # theme-fix2 (r23 g7): a man was found but the install did not take; oe_tg_appoint charged nothing
	                else_if = {
	                    limit = { exists = scope:oe_tg_nominee }
	                    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_g value = 4 }
	                }
	                clear_saved_scope = oe_tg_nominee
	                clear_saved_scope = oe_tg_theme_s
	            }
	        }
	    }
	    # marches: oe_tbd_ai, for this march. theme-fix2 (r23 g7: f=1 but l=0 from pressure 80): whether border troops are
	    # due is read BEFORE the castle is repaired, because the castle's worker oe_tbd.9 recomputes the pressure (with the
	    # castle's cut) and its result was seen before the levy line was read.
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_tbd_levy_target = yes has_variable = oe_tbd_pressure var:oe_tbd_pressure >= 60 }
	        set_variable = oe_tb2_lv_due
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { oe_tbd_fortify_target = yes oe_tbd_hot = yes c:BYZ = { gold >= 300 } }
	        save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme
	        c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_fortify_do = yes change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_f add = 1 } }
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_f value = 1 }
	    }
	    if = {
	        limit = { has_variable = oe_tb2_lv_due oe_tbd_levy_target = yes c:BYZ = { gold >= 150 } }
	        save_scope_as = oe_tbd_act_theme
	        c:BYZ = { oe_tbd_levy_do = yes change_variable = { name = oe_tb2_s_l add = 1 } }
	        clear_saved_scope = oe_tbd_act_theme
	        set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_t_l value = 1 }
	    }
	    remove_variable = oe_tb2_lv_due
	}
}
# BYZ scope (menu oe_tb2.3). All themes that may / all managed themes.
oe_tb2_mg_all_on = { every_subject = { limit = { oe_tb2_mg_can = yes } oe_tb2_mg_on = yes } }
oe_tb2_mg_all_off = { every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_te_managed } oe_tb2_mg_off = yes } }
